inj.note: Cross suffered the injury during Sunday's win over the Chiefs. While an official return date hasn't been established, there is hope he can get back on the field in "one or two weeks." With Cross on the shelf, Josh Jones is the favorite to start in Week 8 versus Chicago and beyond.

news.h: Source: Seahawks LT Charles Cross has high ankle sprain, likely to miss time
news.d: Seahawks left tackle Charles Cross suffered a high ankle sprain and is expected to miss time, a source told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.
